heuristics.name: material-and-mobility
heuristics.plan: Win material, and keep your options open.

heuristics.name: Pure land grab
heuristics.plan: Ignore the enemy entirely and spend every move stepping onto a square nobody has claimed yet, racing to 41.

heuristics.name: Hunter of legal prey
heuristics.plan: Keep only pieces that have something they are allowed to eat on the board, and hunt those targets down to strip the enemy army.

heuristics.name: Fan out and never double back
heuristics.plan: Push every piece forward into enemy ground so each step claims virgin territory and denies them the same.

heuristics.name: Centre clamp
heuristics.plan: Park pieces in the middle where their eight jump lines reach the most squares, and claim outward from there.

heuristics.name: Wake up the rear guard
heuristics.plan: Move the back pieces first so nothing is dead weight, keeping every unit mobile while quietly out-claiming the enemy late.
